recognize_zh: 低倍下黏膜組織（邊緣可見腺體/絨毛狀黏膜）被密集的深藍色淋巴細胞浸潤，形成多個擴大、結節狀的淋巴聚集並破壞正常黏膜結構，可對應套細胞淋巴瘤造成的淋巴瘤性息肉症（lymphomatous polyposis）。
features: Low-power view of mucosal tissue with residual glandular/villous mucosa at the edges
Dense, diffuse and vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and submucosa
Multiple enlarged nodules with slightly paler centers and darker peripheral cuffs
Monotonous dark-staining small cells at this magnification
Distortion and effacement of normal mucosal architecture
describe_en: Low-power section of mucosa-lined tissue, likely gastrointestinal, shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate forming multiple expanded nodules that efface the normal architecture, with residual glandular mucosa at the surface. The nodules have slightly paler centers surrounded by darker cuffs, raising the possibility of a nodular or mantle-zone growth pattern. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of the title, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma involving the gastrointestinal tract; cyclin D1 and SOX11 immunostains are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and well-defined mantles, and are cyclin D1 negative with polytypic light chains.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and plasmacytic differentiation, and is cyclin D1 and CD5 negative.
FL forms back-to-back follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts that are CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
